magic.mushokutenseiorigin.book_page:
Zenith Greyrat's Magic Book

Water Ball
Water magic

Learn the chant to unlock this spell.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.natur:
Magic Primer

Magic uses mana to affect matter. Learn a formula, then control creation, size, speed and release. Check your reserves before casting.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.eleme:
Four Elements

Offensive magic uses water, fire, wind and earth. Water also includes ice and weather. This primer teaches one basic projectile per element.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.ranks:
Ranks

Beginner, intermediate, advanced, saint, king, emperor and god rank describe formula difficulty, not overall combat ability. Master the basics first.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.metho:
Casting

Chants guide a formula. Shortened, omitted and silent forms also exist. Circles have other uses. Here, learning a chant unlocks instant casting.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.pract:
Practice

Load learned spells in Magic Knowledge. Select one with the wheel. Hold Cast to repeat. Each release costs mana and must wait for its cooldown.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.safet:
Safety

Rest when mana runs low. Successful sleep restores mana. Basic shots vanish on impact. Avoid allies. Combined and sustained magic require further study.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.water:
Water Ball
Beginner / Water

Launch a water cube.
Mana: 1
Cooldown: 0.1 s
Damage: 1 HP

Practice aiming and repeated casting.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.fireb:
Fireball
Beginner / Fire

Launch condensed fire.
Mana: 3
Cooldown: 0.6 s
Damage: 3 HP

Fire Resistance blocks it. 80% chance to ignite for 5s.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.wind_:
Wind Ball
Beginner / Wind

Launch compressed air.
Mana: 2
Cooldown: 0.4 s
Damage: 1 HP

A successful hit pushes the target back.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.rock_:
Rock Bullet
Beginner / Earth

Launch a small stone.
Mana: 3
Cooldown: 0.6 s
Damage: 4 HP

Drops faster. Aim higher at long range.

magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.water:
Water Arrow
Beginner / Water
Requires: Water Ball

Mana: 2
Cooldown: 0.3 s
Damage: 2 HP

A swift, narrow shot with little drop.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.ice_s:
Ice Smash
Beginner / Water
Requires: Water Ball

Mana: 4
Cooldown: 0.8 s
Damage: 5 HP

A slower ice block with marked drop. 80% chance to freeze for 5s.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.flame:
Flame Slice
Beginner / Fire
Requires: Fireball
Mana: 4
Cooldown: 0.7s
Damage: 4 HP

Flies 10 blocks. Passes partial cover; full cover stops it. On contact, damages creatures in a 3 by 3 area centered on the hit creature, then vanishes. 80% chance to burn for 5s.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.heali:
Healing
Beginner / Healing

Mana: 8
Cooldown: 3 s
Restores: 4 HP

Heals only yourself. No cost at full health. Does not cure ailments.

magic.mushokutenseiorigin.effect_water_s: Creates a 3 by 2 water screen for 4s, absorbing 8 damage. Stationary repeated casts extend it and restore capacity. Contact slows without drowning.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.water:
Water Shield
Beginner
Requires: Water Ball
Mana: 6
Cooldown: 3s

Creates a 3 by 2 water screen for 4s, absorbing 8 damage. Stationary repeated casts extend it and restore capacity. Contact slows without drowning.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.ice_b:
Ice Blade
Beginner
Requires: Ice Smash
Mana: 5
Cooldown: 1s

Flies straight up to 15 blocks, dealing 5 damage to the first creature. Stops at walls; creates no item.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.heat_:
Heat Hand
Beginner
Requires: Fireball
Mana: 2
Cooldown: 0.5s

Melts one snow or ice block within 4 blocks. Ice becomes water unless it evaporates. Clears freezing and grants 10s warmth.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.effect_heat_is: Creates a fixed radius-3 warm zone for 10s. Clears freezing and wetness. Stationary repeated casts extend it. No damage or terrain changes.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.heat_:
Heat Island
Beginner
Requires: Heat Hand
Mana: 6
Cooldown: 8s

Creates a fixed radius-3 warm zone for 10s. Clears freezing and wetness. Stationary repeated casts extend it. No damage or terrain changes.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.effect_burning: Radius-2 ring; damage on contact each second
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.burni:
Burning Place
Beginner
Requires: Fireball
Mana: 10
Cooldown: 3s

A radius-2 fire ring follows you for 4s. Deals 2 fire damage each second to creatures touching the ring. Repeated casts extend it. Does not damage through walls.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.effect_detoxif: Removes Poison from yourself only. Does not clear Wither or other effects. No poison means no cost or cooldown.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.detox:
Detoxification
Beginner
Requires: None
Mana: 6
Cooldown: 3s

Removes Poison from yourself only. Does not clear Wither or other effects. No poison means no cost or cooldown.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.effect_magic_s: A barrier follows you for 5s, absorbing 8 mod-magic damage and blocking its added effects. Repeated casts extend it and restore capacity.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.magic:
Magic Shield
Beginner
Requires: None
Mana: 8
Cooldown: 4s

A barrier follows you for 5s, absorbing 8 mod-magic damage and blocking its added effects. Repeated casts extend it and restore capacity.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.statu:
Added effects

Water: 60% Wet.
Ice: 80% Frozen.
Fire: 80% burning.

Duration: 5s per rank, up to 35s. Reapplication refreshes duration. Wet has no added effect. Barriers block added effects too.
magic.mushokutenseiorigin.textbook.maint:
Maintaining magic

Hold Cast to pay and extend after each cooldown. Shields regain capacity 8.

Water Shield and Heat Island require standing still. Releasing or moving ends maintenance. Recast replaces it. Switching spells keeps existing effects.
